messages:
Nora Li: Quick UX QA from the dashboard review: table row actions look cramped on touch devices. Icon-only buttons are 28px, should be 40px min per touch guidelines. Screenshot attached.
Sam Patel: Good catch. Which table variant? Dense vs normal?
Nora Li: Dense. We switched to compact-row-height last sprint and didn't update action button sizing.
Lucía Rivera: That's probably the `button.size-compact` token usage. The table cells still assume `cell-padding-2`. We're mixing spacing scales.
Arjun Iyer: Current CSS in table-actions component: ```css
.button.icon-only { width: var(--button-size-compact); height: var(--button-size-compact); padding: 4px; }
.table-row.dense { height: 32px; }
```
Arjun Iyer: Suggested changes: 1) keep dense row height but increase action hit targets to 40px using `--button-touch-target`; 2) adjust cell padding so icons don't visually crowd text; 3) preserve visual density by using overflow ellipsis rather than shrinking touch size.
Mia Chen: accessibility nit: several icon buttons in the row lack `aria-label` (e.g., kebab, pin). Screen reader reads "button" only. We should make aria-label required in the linter for icon-only buttons.
design-bot: lint warning (button-a11y-302): 3 icon-only buttons without `aria-label` found in `components/table-row-actions/*`. Recommend adding labels or `aria-hidden=true` where appropriate.
Sam Patel: Plan: add `--button-touch-target: 40px` token and reference it in icon-only buttons; keep visual icon size at 16px but center it in the larger hitbox. Update table cell padding to `--cell-padding-compact-1` for alignment. Add linter rule for icon-only `aria-label`.
Lucía Rivera: Also consider updating the table docs to show recommended patterns for dense rows with actions — examples for mobile and keyboard navigation.
Arjun Iyer: Code snippet for suggested button style: ```css
.button.icon-only { width: var(--button-touch-target); height: var(--button-touch-target); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.button.icon-only > svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
```
Nora Li: Good. Also saw the focus ring gets clipped when action is near the row edge. Might need `outline-offset` or increase container overflow visible.
Mia Chen: Add that to PR checklist. Ensure keyboard tab order follows row -> actions, and that row-level clickable areas (like the row link) don't capture focus before action buttons.
design-bot: automated check (token-missing-1975): `--button-touch-target` not present in tokens.json. Linter will fail until token is added.
Sam Patel: I'll create the token in tokens.yml (`--button-touch-target: 40px`) and update components/button/icon-only and table-row-actions. I'll also add aria-label linter rule and a short doc example. Assigning to @Sam Patel.
Arjun Iyer: I'll QA the visual diffs and run keyboard + NVDA checks on staging.
Mia Chen: Thanks — please include visual test for mobile width and a11y assertions in the PR.
Sam Patel: PR opened with token, styles, and linter update. Staging link + screenshots included.
Nora Li: Spot-checked staging on iPad and phone widths. Hit targets feel much better, focus ring fixed. A11y check with VoiceOver reads labels properly.
Mia Chen: Reviewed and left one minor comment about example copy in docs. Otherwise approve.
Sam Patel: Addressed doc copy, rebased, merging now.
Mia Chen: Merged. Closing thread. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
